subject: th-cont
title: TH.CONT.------EXP.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 226 (WAC-24). TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: RT-ALGN (reality alignment) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From RT-ALGN: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From MT-INFO: LANG (language) and POL-P (political policies). From LANG: AFL (affinity alignment). From POL-P: RE-DOC (redocumentation) and EXT-F (extended functionalism). From EXT-F: DEC (decentralization).
